description: HubSpot portal template for an Orion self-install. Applied by apply-hubspot-template.mjs. Stages mirror the funnel in agent/knowledge-base/04-methodology-and-motion.md.
object_type_note: Use 'contacts' for a founder or individual seller selling to individuals. Add 'companies' too for a B2B motion — run the script twice, once per object type, for the assessment-profile properties (lifecyclestage is shared).

lifecyclestage.note: Standard HubSpot property, already present on every portal — this template ensures the option set matches the funnel, it does not create the property itself.

assessment_profile_properties.note: Custom properties holding the assessment profile + install metadata — mirrors status/status.json so it's also visible inside the client's own CRM.

deal_pipeline.name: Orion Pipeline
deal_pipeline.note_plan_tier: HubSpot's free/starter tiers support only ONE deal pipeline per portal. If the client is on that tier, RENAME their existing default pipeline instead of creating a new one (Settings → Objects → Deals → Pipelines — a manual UI action, not scriptable). If the client is on Pro+ (multiple pipelines allowed), the apply script can create a dedicated one via the Pipelines API.
deal_pipeline.stages_note: A default starting shape matching the funnel in knowledge base §4 — rename stages to the client's own vocabulary once applied; the lifecyclestage mapping above is the part that must match exactly, Deal-pipeline stage names can vary.

decision_maker_property.note: No new property needed — HubSpot's existing hs_buying_role Contact property (value DECISION_MAKER) is the standard field. Associate the Contact to its Company for a B2B motion.
